questions.stemHtml: A 14-year-old female came in with irritation in the eyes, loss of vision and hazy cornea. Her symptoms began 9 days ago and have been gradually progressive thus prompting her to consult. On examination you notice the cornea is hazy with a steamy surface, giving a general ground glass appearance. The iris is dimly visible. The examination findings are shown below. Her previous medical history is significant for hearing loss and vertigo. Which of the following statements is not correct?

options.label: A
options.text: After the disease has reached its peak, the cornea clears slowly from the margin towards the centre, which may remain hazy for a long time but finally improves except in the worst cases

options.label: B
options.text: Syphilis should be ruled out in this patient

options.label: C
options.text: Local treatment in the form of lubricants, topical steroids and cycloplegics to control the uveitis is helpful in the acute stage

options.label: D
options.text: The slit lamp shows thickening of the cornea and often folds of the Descemet's membrane and an immune ring of the Wessely type
